findings.message: references 5 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: attempts path traversal with encoded or nested patterns
findings.remediation: Use path.resolve() and verify the result stays within the workspace root.
findings.impact: Path traversal with encoded patterns (%2e%2e%2f) or nested ../.. can escape any path-based sandbox.
findings.attack_vector: URL-encoded or nested traversal sequences — bypass naive path validation that only checks single ../.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
